subject: Is there a way to turn clustering on/off in leaflet shiny?

messages.author: a8e7ce40cbbbbdd8
messages.subject: Is there a way to turn clustering on/off in leaflet shiny?
parts:
At the moment I have an action button that clears all marker clusters in an observeEvent function. This just removes the markers altogether but what I really want is the option to uncluster the markers with the click of a button then another button that resets it. Does anyone know how this could be done? 



actionButton("clear", "Clear Marker Clusters")

...

observeEvent(input$clear, {
      leafletProxy("leafletMap") %>% clearMarkerClusters() 
    })
